query:
WITH updated AS (
            UPDATE email_messages m
            SET
                is_starred = $1,
                updated_at = NOW()
            FROM email_links l
            WHERE
                m.id = ANY($2)
                AND m.link_id = l.id
                AND l.fusionauth_user_id = $3
            RETURNING m.id, m.thread_id
        ),
        touch AS (
            UPDATE email_threads t
            SET updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE t.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT thread_id FROM updated)
        )
        SELECT id FROM updated
